reviews.text:
We brought our daughter, Rae, to Tooth Buddy Semenyih after she had a bad fall and chipped her front tooth, exposing the nerve. We were understandably very worried. Dr Lai saw her on the same day and initially explained that there was not much that could be done and that we might have to wait for the baby tooth to eventually fall out.

To our surprise, Dr Lai called us personally the very next morning at around 8am. He told us that he had been thinking about Rae overnight and felt that it would not be ideal for such a young girl to be without her front tooth for several years, as it could potentially affect her appearance and even lead to alignment issues later on. He asked if we could bring her back in to explore treatment options.

When we returned, Rae was understandably frightened and cried throughout the visit. Despite having a fully booked schedule, Dr Lai and his nurses were incredibly patient and understanding. They gave us all the time we needed to comfort Rae and even allowed us to come back again later. Throughout the entire process, they remained calm, gentle, and reassuring, even when Rae accidentally bit one of the nurses' fingers.

What truly touched us was how much Dr Lai genuinely cared. How many dentists would continue thinking about a patient after clinic hours and personally call the family the next morning? Dr Lai even went the extra mile to visit another branch to obtain medication for Rae.

We are deeply grateful for the compassion, professionalism, and dedication shown by Dr Lai and his team. Thank you for treating Rae not just as a patient, but as a little person you truly cared about. We highly recommend Tooth Buddy Semenyih to any parent looking for a dentist who is not only skilled but also exceptionally caring.

I visited this clinic on Monday, which was a public holiday, and was pleasantly surprised that they were open. Prior to my visit, I made an appointment the day before and was given a slot immediately. The staff also took the time to explain the different treatment options covered by insurance and self-payment, which made everything very clear and straightforward.
I arrived at 11:00 AM, registered as usual, and was attended to shortly after by Dr. Vani. She greeted me warmly and spent some time chatting with me about the treatment I wanted. One of the first things she asked was, "Are you nervous?"—which I definitely was! 😅🙈 Dental visits have rarely been good experiences for me.
However, Dr. Vani's communication skills were excellent. She explained each step of the procedure as she was doing it, which immediately put me at ease and gave me confidence throughout the treatment. She was also very gentle and never rough during the procedure. It truly felt like I was being treated by someone who is passionate about her profession and genuinely cares about her patients.
As I am currently 24 weeks pregnant, lying in the dental chair for an extended period can sometimes be uncomfortable. Halfway through the treatment, Dr. Vani offered me a pillow to support my back. It may seem like a small gesture, but it meant a lot to me. I didn't want to trouble anyone by asking, yet she noticed and thought of it herself. That level of attentiveness and care speaks volumes about her experience and compassion.
Overall, I had a very positive experience with both the clinic and Dr. Vani. Professional, caring, gentle, and thoughtful—qualities that every patient hopes to find in a healthcare provider. Highly recommended.

I just want to share my experience today – went to Beyond Dental Care at Olive Hill
Before this, I read a lot of reviews. People said the doctor explains things in detail and the pricing is reasonable, so I decided to give it a try.
And honestly… it’s true.
From the moment we walked in, the service was really good. Friendly, not rushed, and comfortable. The doctor took time to explain everything properly – step by step until we really understood. If you don’t get it the first time, he’ll explain again. Not the kind that just wants to finish quickly.
The consultation was quite long too, not those quick 5-minute sessions. You can ask anything, and he answers patiently. That kind of service is honestly rare these days.
What I respect the most – he actually advised me to go to a government clinic because my case needs a specialist. He could have easily continued treatment and charged me, but instead he chose to be honest and point me to the right place. That says a lot.
Price-wise, it’s very reasonable. I even got 3 types of medication and still felt it was worth it.
Overall, very satisfied.
If you’re looking for a dental clinic around Seri Kembangan, this is definitely a place you can consider. Professional, honest, and very thorough.
Not easy to find this kind of service nowadays. Respect.
